_comment: Metaplex Sugar v2 — Candy Machine v3 Config for REBORNFENIX (RBFX) — v3.0
_deploy_note: Replace all PLACEHOLDER values before deployment. Run 'sugar validate' before 'sugar deploy'.
_architecture: Three guard groups: 'legion' (22,222 × 10 USDC) + 'founding_warrior' (22 × 100 USDC, max 1/wallet) + 'phoenix_army' (522,222 × 0.10 USDC, separate SPL token — see phoenix_army_token.js).
_numerical_signature: 22 · 22.222 · 522.222 — the number 22 runs through the entire project. Total supply: 544,466. Hard cap forever.
_number_note: 22 Founding Warriors + 22,222 Legion of Honour + 522,222 Phoenix Army = 544,466 total tokens. HARD CAP FOREVER.
_isSequential_note: Sequential minting ensures generation colours are assigned in purchase order (Gen 1 → Gen 10).
_hiddenSettings_note: Hidden settings enable pre-mint deployment without uploading all metadata upfront.
After mint is complete, update the base URI to the revealed metadata folder.
hash must be the SHA-256 of the concatenation of all metadata URIs.
Run 'sugar reveal' to trigger the on-chain reveal after all mints complete.
Replace 'REBORNFENIX_BASE_URI_PLACEHOLDER' with your Arweave/IPFS base URI after upload.
_uploadMethod_note: Bundlr (now Irys) for permanent Arweave storage. Alternatives: 'aws', 'nft_storage', 'pinata'.
_treasury_note: All mint proceeds go here. Use a multisig for production.
_goLiveDate_note: Replace with actual go-live UTC timestamp. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

endSettings._note: 22,222 Legion + 22 Founding Warriors (Candy Machine covers NFT tiers only). Phoenix Army (522,222) is a separate SPL token — see phoenix_army_token.js.

_gatekeeper_note: Optional: set to Civic Gateway config for bot protection. null = no captcha.

_note: Three guard groups for the three tiers.
'legion' group: public mint, 10 USDC each, no per-wallet cap (default reasonable limit set).
'founding_warrior' group: 100 USDC each, max 1 per wallet, supply hard-capped at 22.
'phoenix_army' group: entry-level, 0.10 USDC each, no per-wallet limit (accumulate tokens to rank up). Supply hard-capped at 522,222.
NOTE: Phoenix Army is also deployable as a standalone SPL fungible token via phoenix_army_token.js.

deploymentChecklist: 1. Replace ALL PLACEHOLDER values in this config
2. Upload art assets to Arweave/IPFS and get base URIs (founding warrior, legion, phoenix army — separate folders)
3. Upload Legion metadata JSONs using 'sugar upload' (22,222 files)
4. Upload Founding Warrior template JSONs separately (22 files, will be updated post-purchase)
5. Upload Phoenix Army metadata JSON (single fungible token template — 522,222 identical tokens)
6. Run 'sugar validate' to verify config
7. Create collection NFT: 'sugar collection create'
8. Deploy candy machine: 'sugar deploy'
9. Verify THREE guard groups are correctly configured: 'sugar show'
10. Test all three mints on devnet: Founding Warrior (100 USDC), Legion (10 USDC), Phoenix Army (0.10 USDC)
11. Verify mintLimit id:2 (Founding Warrior) enforces max 1 per wallet
12. Verify allocation id:2 hard-caps at 22 Founding Warriors
13. Verify allocation id:3 hard-caps at 522,222 Phoenix Army tokens
14. ALTERNATIVE for Phoenix Army: run 'node phoenix_army_token.js' to deploy as standalone SPL token
15. If using SPL token route: verify mint authority is revoked after deployment (proof of hard cap)
16. Set go-live date and announce
17. After Founding Warrior purchase: collect patron name + zodiac, generate personalised art, update metadata URI
18. After full sellout: run 'sugar reveal' for metadata reveal
19. Verify secondary marketplace royalties are enforced
20. Publish first monthly autism donation proof at https://rebornfenix.io/compromisos

network.rpc_note: Use a private RPC (Helius, QuickNode, Alchemy) for production. Public RPC rate-limits during high traffic.

lore.mission: Born from the fires of Ragnarök. Carrying the wisdom of the Elder Futhark. For every father who kept fighting when the world said stop.
lore.mission_pt: Nascidos dos fogos de Ragnarök. Carregando a sabedoria das Elder Futhark. Por cada pai que continuou a lutar quando o mundo disse para parar.
lore.imperial_purple_lore: In ancient Rome, wearing purple without being Emperor was punishable by death. The 22 Founding Warriors carry this color — not because they claimed it, but because they built the fire that made it possible.
lore.imperial_purple_lore_pt: Na Roma antiga, usar púrpura sem ser Imperador era punível com a morte. Os 22 Founding Warriors carregam esta cor — não porque a reclamaram, mas porque construíram o fogo que a tornou possível.
lore.phoenix_army_lore: The Phoenix Army is the heartbeat of the warband. 522,222 soldiers who each paid one small price and earned one sacred right: to rise. Every token is a step. Every rank is earned. The Fénix does not ask where you started — only how far you are willing to climb.
lore.phoenix_army_lore_pt: O Exército da Fénix é o batimento cardíaco da banda de guerra. 522.222 soldados que pagaram um pequeno preço e ganharam um direito sagrado: subir. Cada token é um passo. Cada posto é conquistado. A Fénix não pergunta onde começaste — apenas até onde estás disposto a chegar.
